relations: As sky bursts cycle green-white to pink to orange-gold, their vertical water reflections recolor in lockstep.
The dotted cluster drifts slowly downward and spreads modestly, preserving its multi-burst shape without new bursts.
Boat and upright silhouettes stay fixed mid-water and right while city lights remain stationary on the horizon.
A faint grey smoke haze lingers above the center-right horizon throughout the color cycle and descent.
caption: The video captures a nighttime scene over a dark pond, where a wide cluster of dotted spherical bursts of light already fills the sky above a horizon lined with city lights. The points of light cycle color in place, shifting from green and white to pink, then to orange-gold with pale blue, back to green, and then to orange-gold and purple-pink. As colors change, the cluster drifts slowly downward and spreads modestly, keeping its multi-burst shape without being replaced by new bursts. The lights cast long vertical colored reflections across the water, their shimmering streaks recoloring in lockstep with the sky. A small boat-like silhouette sits mid-water and a dark upright silhouette rests on the right, both remaining in place. A faint grey smoke haze lingers just above the horizon at center-right throughout. The reflections ripple gently while the city lights stay fixed. The process is still unfolding at the final frame, the dotted bursts continuing their slow color cycle and descent.
